newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian authorities close down Megawati HQ.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian authorities close down Megawati HQ.

text.p: Indonesian authorities closed down the headquarters of ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri on Friday, witnesses said.

They said officials from the local East Jakarta municipality, accompanied by about 30 security guards and police, took over the two-storey house and later put up placards saying it had been closed down.
Only some lawyers were in the building at the time and they were asked to leave, the witnesses said. There was no violence.
The municipality had earlier given Megawati's faction of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) until Friday morning to vacate the building, which it said violated residential zoning laws.

Megawati, daughter of Indonesia's late founding president Sukarno, had set up the office for her faction of the PDI after police raided the official party headquarters on July 27, evicting her supporters and sparking the worst riots in the city of some 10 million people in more than two decades.
She had been ousted from the leadership of the PDI by a government-backed faction in June.
